dossiers.title: Taylor–Red Wash service terms

clauses.label: Parties and duration
clauses.text: ARU supplies terminal/trucking services; BS&T separately supplies rail; RWH is customer. Five-year term: July 7, 2026–July 6, 2031. Each service names its actual seller even when ARU administers billing.

clauses.label: Price and quantity
clauses.text: Combined rates per car: acid $3,010; binder $2,390; lime $2,500; steel $2,725; process/MRO $1,900; qualified project freight $4,600. The 225-slot allowance contains 215 billable cars and ten unbilled contingencies; no minimum-volume or exclusive-carrier covenant.

clauses.label: Service and exceptions
clauses.text: 72 elapsed hours interchange-to-empty-release, 96 for steel; 36–48-hour operating goal. Customer-caused storage may incur $50/car/24 hours, prorated; provider delay earns no such charge. Baseline has zero chargeable dwell.

clauses.label: Billing and exit
clauses.text: Monthly actual quantities and accepted rate versions; payment due within 30 calendar days. Thirty-day curable-breach period. Convenience termination after first year requires 180 days notice and carries no volume penalty.

clauses.label: Asset and custody boundary
clauses.text: RWH owns the $3.25M mine program; ARU the $5.25M Taylor program. The $8.5M phase is separate from tariff revenue. Finished uranium concentrate and a mine rail spur are excluded.

dossiers.accounting: Reconcile reciprocal invoice IDs once across rail, terminal and trucking sellers and the RWH buyer. Eliminate internal balances/income once; preserve external costs and owner depreciation.
dossiers.missing: No authentic executed tariff, insurer certificate or uranium qualification is supplied. Third-party linehaul/demurrage needs its own invoice and governing terms.

dossiers.title: Advisory engagement and outcome terms
dossiers.status: LOCKED DIRECTION; contract architecture, not executed client agreement

clauses.label: Agreement stack
clauses.text: MSA/PSA; required data/security addendum; separate Atlas license; matter SOW/charter; outcome schedule for measurable-value work or transfer schedule for capability work; jurisdiction/client addenda where required.

clauses.label: Required SOW
clauses.text: Name problem, deliverable, success criteria, authority/non-authority, client dependencies, milestones, committed/variable fees, Atlas charges, expenses, data assumptions, IP class, acceptance, change control and stop rights.

clauses.label: Commercial rules
clauses.text: Normal minimum professional fee $150,000, excluding Atlas, travel, third-party costs and taxes; exceptions need documented rationale. Measurable-value default is 60% committed / 40% variable, with approved scope and capped payout mechanics.

clauses.label: Recognition evidence
clauses.text: Committed amounts follow milestone or monthly fixed billing. Variable fees are invoiced only after Value Office certification and contractual dispute procedures. Hours are internal cost/capacity evidence; they do not automatically create billable revenue.

clauses.label: Transfer and exit
clauses.text: Separate client-owned, licensed SH capability, reserved professional IP and nontransferable third-party/institutional material. Unsafe/unlawful requests, falsification demands and material security/conflict issues can stop work.

dossiers.accounting: Trace matter class and accepted fee components separately from Atlas license and pass-through costs. Link certification/acceptance to the chosen released contract and invoice; no imagined executed SOW.
dossiers.missing: Actual client legal parties, negotiated limitations, executed MSA/SOW versions, insurance and counsel implementation are not completed by the standards.

dossiers.title: Atlas licensing and amendment evidence
dossiers.status: LOCKED DIRECTION plus conditional commercial scenarios

clauses.label: License perimeter
clauses.text: Core and Enterprise are client editions; Professional remains the SH-controlled professional plane. Managed adds agreed operated client-plane services. Licensing is institutional/tenant based, not primarily per seat.

clauses.label: Price status
clauses.text: Illustrative market-testing annual bands are Core $150K–$350K and Enterprise $350K–$1.25M. Negotiation depends on scope, connectors, environments and support. These are not binding public offers or issued invoices.

clauses.label: Separation
clauses.text: Material implementation is priced separately. Client-transferred agents cannot depend silently on unlicensed Professional resources. Tenant, data, access, connector and export boundaries remain documented.

clauses.label: Amendment record
clauses.text: The operating successor supplies immutable contract versions with effective rate, seats, term, approval ID and applied month. Positive changes bill the remaining term; contraction/cancellation credits unearned claims rather than recognized service.

clauses.label: Service-credit boundary
clauses.text: Monthly modeled service demand and breach consequences are not uptime evidence or a negotiated contractual SLA. Earned-service credits reduce revenue and cannot reduce ARR/deferred revenue twice.

dossiers.accounting: Join contract_id, scenario and month across contract_versions, commercial_changes, invoices, credit notes and commercial_deferred_rollforward. Separate license revenue, implementation, cash and ARR.
dossiers.missing: No full executed customer license, actual operational SLA result or signed amendment follows from synthetic approval IDs.

dossiers.title: Colocation orders and SLA review

clauses.label: Selected providers
clauses.text: Switch TAHOE RENO is the primary transition selection; IDACORE Boise is independent recovery. Both selections are accepted direction; neither is executed procurement, reserved capacity or installed service.

clauses.label: Reno order
clauses.text: RT-SO-RENO requests 75/100 kW alternatives with expansion toward 200–250 kW. The $350/kW/month finance input is analyst assumption, not a Switch quote. Building/enclosure/legal provider party/commencement are unverified.

clauses.label: Boise order
clauses.text: RT-SO-BOISE uses a 25 kW recovery envelope with 50/100 kW expansion cases. Published $300/kW/month actual-draw pricing is a procurement baseline; meter intervals, minimums, charges and term ambiguity require order resolution.

clauses.label: Proposed remedies
clauses.text: Power availability is measured per affected delivery point, separate from application uptime. Proposed credits are 5/10/25/50% by outage band, capped at 50% of affected recurring facility charges; not accepted provider obligations.

clauses.label: Access and exit
clauses.text: Proposed authenticated remote-hands work orders exclude data/key access. Customer retains equipment/data/keys. Proposed 90-day transition and no obstructive liens require negotiated legal acceptance.

dossiers.accounting: No vendor payable at provider selection. Keep colo service cost, deposits/prepayments, IT hardware and owned-site capital separate; do not duplicate power charges in a power-inclusive rate.
dossiers.missing: Legal provider entities, quotes, executed orders, insurance, access/audit rights, technical acceptance and control-period reports are still needed.

dossiers.title: Legal entities and separate books

clauses.label: Parent and holding chain
clauses.text: SHI is Sable Harbor, LLC, a Delaware LLC with Sacramento headquarters. It owns SHIH, a Delaware corporation; SHIH owns Pale Sun and ARU; Pale Sun owns RWH; ARU owns BS&T. Each subsidiary interest is 100%.

clauses.label: Operating boundary
clauses.text: Pale Sun holds its platform investment/payroll; RWH its mine assets, permits, inventory and liabilities. ARU owns reusable logistics assets and BS&T retains rail property, employees and operating books.

clauses.label: Formation precision
clauses.text: SHI founding remains 2016 year precision. SHIH December 2, 2024 and Pale Sun January 13, 2025 are derived fictional formation dates, not registry findings or actual certificate dates.

clauses.label: Authority
clauses.text: Entity creation, material debt/guarantees/security, consequential M&A and material related-party exposures ordinarily go to the Board. No mechanical dollar ladder or investor ordinary-operations veto is invented.

dossiers.accounting: Join entity_id and owner_entity_id before combining books. A management unit or J2 capability is not another legal company; no double posting from organizational displays.
dossiers.missing: No government certificate number, tax identifier, actual registry filing or signed operating agreement is provided. SHI federal tax classification remains unresolved outside the industrial acquisition model.

dossiers.title: Financing approvals and capital boundaries

clauses.label: 2021 approval
clauses.text: June 18 minutes approve entry into definitive documents for approximately $48M Harrison Vale financing, subject to final legal review and no material adverse terms. Evan Mercer board appointment is effective on closing.

clauses.label: 2022 approval
clauses.text: October 28 minutes approve approximately $135M Wolf Ridge financing at approximately $900M post-money; no founder secondary; working ownership approximately 66.5% insiders and 33.5% outside capital.

clauses.label: Rights retained
clauses.text: Investor directors serve SH, not an operating constituency. Neither investor gets ordinary-operations veto or privileged commercial access. Exact thresholds/side letters are not supplied by minutes.

clauses.label: Current governance
clauses.text: One nine-member Board; Kincaid is independent Chair and Daniel Mercer is CEO. Founder name correction is not a new meeting, seat or financing event.

dossiers.accounting: Use approved approximate financing facts and native capital records; do not substitute the 66.5/33.5 working split for a full share-level capitalization or book journal.
dossiers.missing: Full subscription agreements, side letters, option-pool mechanics and cash bank confirmations are not supplied here.

dossiers.title: ARU transition and retention obligations

clauses.label: Operating authority
clauses.text: Nora Ashcombe is President/COO at close; Seth Kettering remains BS&T GM. Fred Tolman retains no dispatch, hiring, capital, contract or operating command authority.

clauses.label: Consultancy
clauses.text: January 7–October 7, 2026; $225,000 total as knowledge-transfer services are performed. Nora commissions work and accepts records. Share price and retention are separate.

clauses.label: Retention allocations
clauses.text: Nora $100K; Gareth $60K; Tessa $60K; Owen $50K; Seth $80K; Derek $50K; Marta $50K; Inez $50K. Total $500K; each has half at six months and half at twelve months.

clauses.label: Conditions and timing
clauses.text: Installments July 7, 2026 and January 7, 2027 depend on continued service/protected departure. Pro rata protections and cause limitations are stated in the source. Scheduled installments do not prove payment.

clauses.label: No acquisition disguise
clauses.text: No award depends on headcount reduction, hidden subsidy or guaranteed Red Wash volume. Property CBAs and safety obligations remain intact.

dossiers.accounting: Compare the eight retention allocations to $500K and each $250K installment; reconcile earned/service cost and cash according to native periods. Keep Tolman consulting and seller proceeds distinct.
dossiers.missing: Individual signed originals and independent payroll-payment evidence are absent. Do not create new employees, protected-departure events or completed milestones.

dossiers.title: Advisory carry and workforce instrument boundaries

clauses.label: Instrument
clauses.text: Contractual phantom carry; 10,000 notional units, not shares. Pool is 20% of Excess Advisory Economic Profit after losses, reserves and the greater of 10% allocated operating capital or enterprise-approved capital charge.

clauses.label: Eligibility
clauses.text: Qualifying former J2 service permits consideration, not a grant. Serving J2 personnel cannot receive individualized grant discussions, previews or promises; HQ service alone creates no eligibility.

clauses.label: Vesting and distributions
clauses.text: Default five years, 20% each completed year without cliff. Annual distributions require Finance-certified/audited results, reserves, dispute accruals and approval. Two-year rolling holdback may apply.

clauses.label: No governance rights
clauses.text: Units create no Board vote, veto, management role, J2 access or ownership of IP. Unallocated units accrue to no person. Individual grants, tax treatment and counsel instrument are separate.

clauses.label: General compensation
clauses.text: P&C direction supports fair cash compensation, profit participation and conservatively structured employee ownership. It does not establish a completed ESOP, grant roster or executed employment contracts.

dossiers.accounting: Use approved plan definition only for scoped hypothetical calculations; never book a named award or tax treatment without an accepted individual instrument and financial source.
dossiers.missing: No grants are created. Counsel must resolve legal/tax/withholding/deferred-compensation implementation; no new ESOP financing or employee ownership percentages.

dossiers.title: Red Wash purchase and closing-rights schedule

clauses.label: Transfer and consideration
clauses.text: Pale Sun buys all RWH interests from Northstar on July 18, 2025. $42M operating assets + $4.5M current assets − $16M ARO − $2.5M other liabilities = $28M identifiable net assets and consideration; zero selected goodwill/transaction debt.

clauses.label: Seller allocation
clauses.text: $24.5M direct payment + $3M environmental/title escrow + $0.5M holdback = $28M. Escrow and holdback are included, not additional uses. The separate stabilization program is $11M: $8M capital and $3M expense.

clauses.label: Rights and deliveries
clauses.text: The equity instrument retains the mine operator and scheduled assets/permits/contracts. The bill-of-sale section covers listed assets, inventory, source records and transferable rights only as law permits; it is not proof of completed consent.

clauses.label: Risk and transition
clauses.text: The $3M escrow has a 36-month term for specified title/environmental matters. NMI transition assistance is up to six months at cost plus 5%, without operating, safety, personnel or capital authority.

clauses.label: Source discrepancy
clauses.text: Industrial and mine documents disagree on exact pre-close re-trade/walk-away dates. The higher-level canon locks the sequence and July 18 close, not those conflicting day-level details.

dossiers.accounting: Reconcile consideration and escrow once. Keep current-cost closure estimate distinct from accounting ARO, and mine stabilization distinct from ARU catch-up capital.
dossiers.missing: Individual title cures, permit/consent proof, bank confirmations and escrow releases are not demonstrated by a closing-delivery list. Preserve the date discrepancy for chronology exercises.

dossiers.title: ARU share purchase, closing and tax bridge
dossiers.status: LOCKED CASE TERMS; tax filing not established

clauses.label: Parties and close
clauses.text: SHIH acquires all ARU shares January 7, 2026 from Fred 60%, Adele 20%, Nora 10%, Seth 10%; no rollover, earn-out or statutory merger. Nora and Seth continue as employees.

clauses.label: EV and consideration
clauses.text: $62M EV − $16M gross debt + $3.5M cash = $49.5M seller equity value. After $1.5M excess-cash distribution, buyer consideration is $48M: $45M direct plus $3M escrow.

clauses.label: Funding and leases
clauses.text: $13.5M old debt payoff plus $48M consideration = $61.5M before fees, funded by $22.5M new term debt and $39M parent equity. Fees add $0.9M expense and $0.3M debt costs. $2.5M leases remain and are not paid off twice.

clauses.label: Adjustment and protection
clauses.text: $4.5M working-capital peg excludes cash, debt/leases, income tax and separately scheduled reserves/claim. Closing statement: 60 days; seller objection: 30 days. General survival 18 months; environmental survival five years.

clauses.label: Tax boundary
clauses.text: Intended joint §338(h)(10) case retains synthetic eligibility facts and conditional PPA/tax allocation. ARU-CL-07 is filing-ready March 2; actual IRS submission/acceptance is not established.

dossiers.accounting: Reconcile native stock basis, retained liabilities, book PPA and independent tax allocation; keep seller excess cash, fees, retention, consultancy and separate $11M catch-up capital out of stock consideration.
dossiers.missing: No IRS filing proof, actual lender confirmation, title/lien release or independently appraised PPA is supplied. Use the source tax memorandum as a dated case record, not a current professional opinion.

dossiers.title: Cradle host rights and material title
dossiers.status: LOCKED HOST BOUNDARIES; precise terms intentionally unassigned

clauses.label: Kelly Gang Mining
clauses.text: External Tasmanian operator retains host-plant command. Cradle owns/maintains recovery equipment, has exclusive recovery right to designated Stream 17 material during agreement term, and receives title at defined capture point.

clauses.label: Commercial allocation
clauses.text: Cradle bears direct recovery cost; Kelly Gang receives negotiated participation in realized recovered-product value. Canon intentionally does not fix percentage, exact price, tonnage or permanent margin.

clauses.label: Demotte
clauses.text: External West Virginia treatment operator retains treatment/discharge duties and immediate stop/bypass authority. Cradle recovery rights cover only captured intervention material; no host mine or remediation asset transfers.

clauses.label: Bedford and genealogy
clauses.text: Bedford is the Fairmont-area development/upgrading center, separate from the host treatment site. Trace stream, sample/assay, recovery, captured intermediate, Bedford batch, product acceptance, host settlement and financial record.

clauses.label: Plan distinction
clauses.text: Site/building layouts are modelled planning views. An external host context view is not a deed, plant ownership or authority to operate the host process.

dossiers.accounting: Use captured quantity and downstream acceptance before revenue/host settlement. Do not consolidate host payroll, plant or treatment liabilities; use selected model participation assumptions explicitly.
dossiers.missing: Full negotiated host term dates, final capture specification, signed instruments and independent title/settlement proof are not supplied by the closeout.

dossiers.title: Northern Nevada planning deed and cost boundary
dossiers.status: ACCEPTED FICTIONAL LAND ACQUISITION; no real conveyance

clauses.label: Accepted planning event
clauses.text: Fictional 7.5-acre Northern Nevada parcel, $3M planning consideration, acquisition September 4, 2026. As of September 11: land acquired/preconstruction; no vertical building, installed critical plant or operating owned data center.

clauses.label: Parties and geometry
clauses.text: Mock grantor TRIC Development Holdings is fictional; grantee Sable Harbor, LLC maps to SHI. Approximate planning pin 39.5450, −119.4550 is not a real APN, cadastral parcel, recorded deed or metes-and-bounds survey.

clauses.label: Cost boundary
clauses.text: $15.5M Phase-I envelope includes the $3M land; about $12.5M remains before production IT hardware. Do not represent the full envelope as spent. Studies are a $200K forecast, not invoices.

clauses.label: Settlement and readiness
clauses.text: The executable land adjustment uses unresolved settlement clearing; it claims no paid cash, accepted vendor payable or loan. Construction commitment and migration require separately evidenced financial/technical gates.

dossiers.accounting: Land is separate from depreciating buildings/plant/hardware and from colo service. Use the runtime adjustment source; never invent a bank disbursement to balance the $3M event.
dossiers.missing: Real title documents, utility commitments, permits, provider quotes and settlement evidence are not present. Preserve accepted fictional land status while retaining these limits.

dossiers.title: Campus and operating-site tenure review
dossiers.status: MIXED RECORDED SITE STATES; plans do not establish title

clauses.label: Sacramento
clauses.text: The integrated campus program and saved plans express accepted functions and explicit planning assumptions. The primary corporate/J2 location is Sacramento; that decision alone does not supply a lease, recorded parcel title or completed construction.

clauses.label: Willow and Bedford
clauses.text: Fort sheds/Museum and Bedford building functions are source-backed concepts. Read each plan title/status and exact site record before asserting measured floor area, ownership dates or occupation.

clauses.label: Industrial sites
clauses.text: Keep mine, rail, terminal, trucking and warehouse functions with their accepted operating anchors. A structure plan cannot supply missing track engineering, underground workings, surveyed rights or an acquisition instrument.

clauses.label: External and historical
clauses.text: Coverage includes external hosts, historical sites and unresolved locations. These dispositions are retained; a mapped counterparty does not become a subsidiary or owned workplace.

dossiers.accounting: Join facility/site/building ID and source status before allocating property cost. Seats/areas are planning capacity, not employee count, lease commitment or recognized PPE.
dossiers.missing: Exact unsupported deeds, leases, parcel surveys, occupancy dates and construction certificates remain individual source gaps; plans cannot fill them.
